problem:
Consider the vectors ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{3}$ and the block diagonal matrix $B$ shown below, where both $2\times 2$ blocks of $B$ represent rotation-scaling matrices:

$$
{v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}-3+4\text{i} \\ 2\text{i} \\ -7+4\text{i} \\ -6+4\text{i}\end{aligned}],\,{v}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}-2-6\text{i} \\ -3+2\text{i} \\ -6+\text{i} \\ -5-\text{i}\end{aligned}],\,B=[\begin{aligned}3 & -7 & 0 & 0 \\ 7 & 3 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2 & -4 \\ 0 & 0 & 4 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

The vectors ${v}_{1}$ and ${v}_{3}$ are the eigenvectors of a matrix $A$ corresponding to the eigenvalues ${\lambda }_{1}=3-7\text{i}$ and ${\lambda }_{3}=2-4\text{i},$ respectively. 
Given that $A=PB{P}^{-1},$ which of the following could be the matrix $P?$
